integrity: The proof combines the maximal-subgroup structure of A5 with an exhaustive permutation replay over every nonidentity 3-subset. The computation constructs A5 from permutations, tests generation and minimality directly, and independently verifies every graph statistic in the claim.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is an exact finite classification for A5 rather than a general nonsoluble-group theorem.
The maximal-subgroup argument is specific to the rigid subgroup geometry of A5.
An equivalent finite computation may exist under irredundant-generating-set terminology not located in the searches.
title: The size-three independence graph of \(A_5\)
